And rapid growth is on the horizon for you too.

And an hour ago I was a cleaner, now a courier, and by evening I can become a cook again.
And then tomorrow I will become a famous lawyer!
Alright, we place our feet shoulder-width apart.
Our back is straight, and now we swing!

meanings.en: to put, to place in an upright position
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'тавить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to put, to place', paired with 'поставить'.

examples.text: Так, ставим ноги на ширине плеч.
examples.trans: Alright, we place our feet shoulder-width apart.

examples.text: Иногда мы бежим от них, думая, что всё можно оставить как есть.
examples.trans: Sometimes we run from them, thinking that everything can be left as it is.

examples.text: Куда ставить тарелку?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'us', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Я тоже не понимаю, встречаемся мы или нет.
examples.trans: I also do not understand whether we are dating or not.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('straight').

examples.trans: Our back is straight, and now we swing!

examples.text: О, привет, молодец, что зашёл, мы прямо скучали!
examples.trans: Oh, hi, good job dropping by, we really missed you!

examples.text: Это прямая поддержка от президента.
examples.trans: This is direct support from the president.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'now', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Я теперь снова здесь повар.
examples.trans: Now I am a cook here again.

examples.text: Подожди, значит, я теперь уборщик?

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('main / basic').

examples.text: Это основной удар в нашем гольфе.
examples.trans: This is the basic stroke in our golf.

examples.text: Шеф говорит, что это очень основной выбор.
examples.trans: The chef says that this is a very main choice.

examples.text: Витя, можешь идти куда хочешь.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'golf' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Вообще, кстати, сколько в этот гольф играть?
examples.trans: In general, by the way, how long do you play this golf?

examples.text: Это основной удар в нашем гольфе.

examples.text: Это точно настоящий гольф?
examples.trans: Is this definitely real golf?

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Вот теперь точно испортила, спасибо, Айнура.
examples.trans: Now you definitely ruined it, thank you, Ainura.

examples.text: Да, в таком виде точно никуда.
examples.trans: Yes, looking like that, definitely nowhere.

examples.text: Это точно настоящий гольф?
examples.trans: Is this definitely real golf?

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'стоящий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('real').

examples.text: Настоящие актёры в хорошем кино играют.
examples.trans: Real actors act in good cinema.

examples.text: Это точно настоящий гольф?
examples.trans: Is this definitely real golf?

examples.text: Это настоящий успех!
examples.trans: This is real success!
